correctness.rationale: The type-IV and eight-I1 fiber divisor follows from the exact discriminant and minimal model at infinity. Standard Shioda--Tate and height pairing results give geometric rank 6 and minimum positive section height 4/3. Integral minimum sections have polynomial degrees at most (2,3), are forced to have X(0)=Y(0)=0, and Y linear coefficient ±2. Comparing all remaining coefficients yields the two explicit equations whose elimination has three normalized roots; b=0 gives three others. Thus 27 positive-sign sections and their 27 negatives are distinct and exhaustive. Exact SymPy checking reproduces the coefficient identities and squarefree resultant. The splitting field is normal and obtained by adding eighth roots over the cyclotomic 2-extension Q(zeta_8), so its Galois group is a 2-group. No unproved numerical extrapolation is used.

originality.rationale: Choudhry first publicly introduced the specific elliptic model in November 2026, proving the non-torsion of (0,2t) and generating multiples, with no 54-section radical census in its §2.1. Shioda (1995, §§4--5) DOES prove the general rank-six \(E_6^*\) lattice, 54 minimum-height sections and a generic algorithm for them; those generic facts are not claimed to be original. The newly evaluated claim is the explicit factorization into a zero-coefficient triple and three eighth-root packets, and the resulting special 2-group arithmetic coefficient field. Neither a direct formula nor its 2-group arithmetic consequence was found in the inspected primary sources, accessible historical scientific claims, targeted web searches, or published mathematical-record searches. Residual risk: a published specialization may have been missed, and the general Shioda construction implies an algorithmic route, so the claim concerns an exact nontrivial specialization, not an independent general theory.
residual_risks: A not-yet-indexed application of Shioda's generic 27-section formulas to exactly this 2026 curve could already exhibit the same radical packets.

value.rationale: This is a natural completion of the minimum-height geometry of a newly published elliptic curve arising from Brahmagupta's square problem. It provides a complete exact 54-section formula but more importantly discovers the arithmetic collapse to a 2-group coefficient field, in sharp contrast to generic \(W(E_6)\) 27-line monodromy. The 3+8+8+8 radical parameter structure is an exact natural invariant useful for future arithmetic descent and specializations; it is neither a routine restatement of the known abstract 54-count nor an arbitrary finite numerical slice. It does not claim an arithmetic Mordell-Weil rank or the complete original Diophantine classification.
